scope: Picture-only handoff; native installation and contextual geometry acceptance outstanding
colour_space: sRGB colour; linear R height/roughness; linear RGB OpenGL normal, +Y; no ORM packing

sets.name: brick_english
sets.notes: Photographic faces reassembled in 24-course English bond, 8 stretchers/16 headers, 6 mm lime joints. Colour/height share the same layout. Check quoin junctions in town.

sets.name: bluestone_ashlar
sets.notes: 50 cm courses, alternating half-block joints, 6 mm mortar. Arrises are relief only; exposed silhouette bevels require geometry at integration.

sets.name: sandstone_ashlar
sets.notes: 50 cm courses, alternating half-block joints, 6 mm mortar. Arrises are relief only; exposed silhouette bevels require geometry at integration.

sets.name: prison_bluestone
sets.notes: 50 cm courses, alternating half-block joints, 6 mm mortar. Arrises are relief only; exposed silhouette bevels require geometry at integration.

sets.name: coping_bluestone
sets.notes: Four 0.75 m caps across. Top edge and lower lip must be modelled; no painted bevel highlight. A 3 m by 0.75 m front-face strip, not a ground stain.

sets.name: slate_ardennes
sets.notes: Six slates across, eight 25 cm exposures; image top is ridgeward. 4-6 mm split slate; near-visible roof laps need actual geometry.

sets.name: brick_brabant
sets.notes: Same local brick sizes as row 3; remap UV scale rather than stretch 128x96 legacy cells.

sets.name: lead_roof
sets.notes: Rolled seams each 0.5 m. Metallic 1 for exposed lead; no orange iron rust. Build exposed sheet edges and prominent rolls in geometry.

sets.name: sandstone_plain
sets.notes: Continuous mineral surface for carved stone and plaster; never paint masonry joints across a statue or moulding.

sets.name: bronze_cast
sets.notes: Patina changes roughness only. Use metalness mask for oxide when wiring; no raised ground plate.

sets.name: wood_oak
sets.notes: Five boards; grain runs horizontally. Rotate every map together for vertical members.

sets.name: zinc_sheet
sets.notes: Period dull zinc sheet, no modern galvanized spangle. Lead seam excluded from this cut.

sets.name: earth_bare
sets.notes: Central continuous soil crop; no baked circular decal silhouette.

sets.name: water_base
sets.notes: Neutral absorption base only; existing native water animation/reflection must supply waves and light. Height deliberately flat; never bake ripples into water colour.

sets.name: wood_dark
sets.notes: Retained photographic row 6 source, commit 73a5fb50; matched structural height. No retired scene/builder is used.

sets.name: wood_single
sets.notes: Single continuous board cut between the inherited plank joints. Use on beams, spokes and solid painted panels so plank gaps are not painted across solid timber. Grain runs horizontally.

sets.name: wrought_iron
sets.notes: Photographic original from 042db687, matching height retained. Surface rust has no ground collision.

sets.name: bark_fissured
sets.notes: CC0 oak fissures, also a generic fissured-bark donor for elm/lime/willow; species-specific form remains model geometry.

sets.name: bark_plane
sets.notes: Exfoliating plane pigmentation stays flat; only fine flake grain enters relief.

sets.name: bark_atlas
sets.notes: Do not repeat across the half-atlas boundary. Use existing native half-cell UVs; each half tiles independently. Plane normal strength already baked at 6 mm, fissured at 18 mm.
sets.licence: CC0-1.0 fissured-bark donor plus original generated plane bark

sets.name: tree_leaves
sets.notes: Each 256 px cell is a 0.5 m square card. Preserve species indices and native cell UVs. Leaf veins remain pigment; no invented raised outline. Flat normal appropriate to thin two-sided leaves; real branch thickness is geometry.

sets.name: park_leaves
sets.notes: Each 256 px cell is a 0.5 m square card. Preserve species indices and native cell UVs. Leaf veins remain pigment; no invented raised outline. Flat normal appropriate to thin two-sided leaves; real branch thickness is geometry.

sets.name: clutter
sets.notes: Native normalized cell rectangles preserved. Repeat within cells only; whole-atlas 3x3 is a layout check. Authored lettering, food, figurative ornaments and unsupported cells retained; these are not claimed upgraded.
